articles.summary: MasterCraft celebrates five years of its empowering “Let Her Rip on Water” campaign, expanding to seven U.S. cities in 2025. With support from Progressive and Chevrolet, the initiative offers free clinics led by pro female athletes to inspire confidence and inclusivity in watersports.
articles.title: MasterCraft celebrates 5 years of empowering women with nationwide “Let Her Rip” on-water campaign

articles.summary: MasterCraft marks the fifth anniversary of its bold “Let Her Rip on Water” campaign, celebrating a half-decade of empowering watersports enthusiasts with innovation, performance, and lifestyle-driven storytelling that fuels the brand’s legacy.
